card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS words and headings
card.fires_on: Words written in all capital letters, often partway through a long capitalized word or in a capitalized heading or instruction. Also the next word in a capitalized sentence such as SHOULD or KNOW.

modes.label: Partway through capitalized words
modes.description: Middle or end pieces of a long all-caps word such as PHYSICIAN or VISUAL.
modes.example: APPLY PATCH TO AFFECTED AREA 1 TO 2 TIMES DAILY OR AS DIRECTED BY PHYS<<IC>>IAN.

modes.label: Whole-word caps in headings
modes.description: Plain words inside an all-caps heading or sentence, such as KNOW or SHOULD.
modes.example: WHAT IS THE MOST IMPORTANT INFORMATION I SHOULD<< KNOW>> ABOUT ESTERIFIED ESTROGENS

card.writes: It promotes odd capital-letter fragments, so it suggests the model should keep writing in capital letters, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on words printed in all capitals, especially in the middle of a long capitalized word in a heading or warning.
